industry.why: Neutral, carried; the sectors are split (Testing B, Recruitment D, the rest C) and carry the view. Relative strength B (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; C prior). Kepler (26-Nov) likes testing and inspection (Bureau Veritas, a private equity approach) and Hatzius (Goldman, 22-Nov) sees early signs of AI weighing on the job market, which is one sector up and one down. No change.

sector.why: Neutral, carried: subscription revenue is defensive and the AI-replacement fear is being tested; no source spoke to the sector; relative strength B (27-Nov-26 against 25-Sep-26, not week on week; D prior). Pool names Pearson, Springer Nature, Wolters Kluwer. Held Neutral until relief shows in sell-side estimates; to B if relative strength holds B with a source carrying the read.

geography.why: Neutral, carried. No source spoke to the Netherlands as a market (Adyen and ING were spoken to as companies); one live holding, IMCD (4.15%). An absence is an absence; no tilt.
